cancellation_family.evolution_warning: Cancellation is an initial condition, not an invariant. Massive and radiation components have different evolution, so total stress can become nonzero.
cancellation_family.status: All initial total cancellations are below3e-13. Preserve raw residuals and mark total orientation unresolved; component orientations remain resolved when nonzero.

reused_targeted_validation.reason_not_repeating: Existing targeted author controls and separate original-owner729 initial review resolve the identified risks; no additional benchmark or broad rerun is needed.

review_findings.evidence: parameters() sets gamma=nu=alpha_r and overrides only massive_quadrupole=alpha_m. Separate positive stress-per-alpha calibrations feed initial_seed(). H includes the same shear correction for both components. The grid yields independent signed Sigma/Pi_m/Pi_r; zero signs are canonical.

Split PreparedContext overrides the old common-alpha guard with split parameter validation. It reuses fixed owner source/rate/radial/angular fields only, constructs a new model dictionary and massive_weight array per case, resets counters, and invokes original initial() for new moments, gas, UV, and proxy. No owner evolution method is replaced.

normalize_row recomputes D_m=Pi_massive and D_r=Pi_gamma+Pi_nu+Pi_UV from every current row. It is applied to the actual initial state and every owner history row. Original owner final references the last history row, so final component values are fresh too. Matter here is the selected collisionless massive nonbaryonic component; gas and remaining cold matter are isotropic in the owner.

D_total=D_m+D_r is formed before invariants(). kappa_time=3*C15.KAPPA=8*pi*G/c^2. Pi_m/Pi_r use separate absolute norms, signed components are retained, and Pi_component_norm_sum is diagnostic only. Both half-contraction and sqrt(2)-scaled Frobenius outputs are present.

Opposite component signs retain raw pressure differences and signed Pi values. Total norm uses the signed sum, not the sum of component magnitudes. Below 3e-13 each component/total orientation is separately labelled unresolved without clipping. Component work=2*s*D_component and total work=2*s*D_total; floating reduction residual is recorded. All-zero cancellation_fraction is defined as0 rather than dividing by0. Initial cancellation is not assumed invariant in evolution.

run_case keeps owner integration and physical/ledger/number gates. It verifies achieved initial signed Sigma/Pi_m/Pi_r/total coordinates, positivity, finite strict JSON export, and table-domain state. Source and toolchain hashes are checked before owner loading in run_group.

Source binding includes frozen owner files, split adapter, both contracts, prior adapter, norm mapper, and source fetch manifest. Group inputs bind source/input/toolchain. --scope imports only PASS/returncode0 result files whose receipt SHA256 matches. Aggregation rejects wrong split schema, status, science binding, owner_ref, step count, conflicting duplicate case, wrong case descriptor, false stored gates, incomplete history, and final-a mismatch. Output order is sorted by case ID. Concurrency remains executor policy.

Plot deltas use actual final minus actual initial fields. Slice meshes use signed independent matter/radiation axes; cancellation annotation is the algebraic initial-condition line. Component curves use each current component and total panel reads Pi_total_half. Provenance hashes cases/history/summary/current contract plus plot and helper code and carries science binding/owner reference. There is no substitute or manufactured output data in the plotting code.
